document.body:
condition_id: bulge, family: deformation, subsidiary: ceat, display_name: Sidewall Ply Separation / Bulge, severity: Critical, primary_failure_mode: Catastrophic Carcass Blowout under highway loading, visual_signature: geometry: Localized radial protrusion or bubble >15mm diameter, texture: Discontinuous sidewall curvature under ArUco normal, hsv_range: Uniform tyre black with distinct shadow gradient, quarantine_mandated: True, governing_standard: CEAT-QC-TY-02 / ISO 10191

condition_id: cut, family: crack_cut, subsidiary: ceat, display_name: Tread or Sidewall Penetration Cut, severity: High, primary_failure_mode: Breaker belt steel wire rust & structural ply rupture, visual_signature: geometry: Sharp linear fissure penetrating outer rubber gauge, texture: High-contrast edge discontinuity across tread rib, hsv_range: Dark localized shadow cleft, quarantine_mandated: False, governing_standard: ASTM F538

condition_id: uneven_wear, family: wear, subsidiary: ceat, display_name: Heel-and-Toe / Shoulder Chamfer Wear, severity: Moderate, primary_failure_mode: Premature tread life loss and asymmetric braking pull, visual_signature: geometry: Differential groove depth between outer and inner ribs, texture: Scalloped or diagonal feathering along block edges, hsv_range: Grayscale depth profile deviation, quarantine_mandated: False, governing_standard: CEAT-FLEET-MAINT-04

condition_id: bead_damage, family: wear, subsidiary: ceat, display_name: Torn Bead Wire / Seating Lip Distortion, severity: Critical, primary_failure_mode: Sudden tubeless air loss & rim dislodgement, visual_signature: geometry: Torn rubber exposing bronze-coated steel bead bundles, texture: Rough jagged boundary at rim contact interface, hsv_range: Metallic luster embedded in black elastomer matrix, quarantine_mandated: True, governing_standard: CEAT-QC-TY-02

condition_id: mould, family: contamination_mould, subsidiary: harrisons, display_name: Superficial / Penetrating Fungal Mould Colony, severity: High, primary_failure_mode: Microbial breakdown of polyisoprene polymer chains, loss of tensile modulus, visual_signature: geometry: Circular or diffuse spore patches spreading across ribs, texture: Velvety or granular high-frequency surface scatter, hsv_range: H: 35-85 (Olive green / dull yellow), S: 30-180, V: 40-200, quarantine_mandated: True, governing_standard: HML-GREEN-BOOK-RSS Clause 2.3

condition_id: colour_unevenness, family: colour_appearance, subsidiary: harrisons, display_name: Uneven Smoke Curing / Dark Clouding, severity: Moderate, primary_failure_mode: Inconsistent cure index (tc90) during downstream tyre compounding, visual_signature: geometry: Broad blotches contrasting with amber baseline, texture: Smooth transition without fungal spore texture, hsv_range: H: 15-30, delta-V > 35 across illuminated inspection tray, quarantine_mandated: False, governing_standard: HML-GREEN-BOOK-RSS Clause 3.2

condition_id: bubbles, family: colour_appearance, subsidiary: harrisons, display_name: Latex Gas Fermentation Bubbles, severity: Moderate, primary_failure_mode: Internal structural void pockets lowering tear resistance, visual_signature: geometry: Clusters of spherical translucent pinhead inclusions <3mm, texture: Local specular highlights under polarized backlighting, hsv_range: High brightness void rings with darker centers, quarantine_mandated: False, governing_standard: HML-GREEN-BOOK-RSS Clause 4.2

condition_id: zinc_loss, family: corrosion_coating, subsidiary: kec, display_name: Galvanic Zinc Depletion / White Storage Stain, severity: Moderate, primary_failure_mode: Loss of sacrificial zinc anode layer exposing underlying carbon steel, visual_signature: geometry: Patchy degradation of bright spangle crystallization, texture: Chalky matte film or pitted micro-roughness, hsv_range: Dull neutral gray, low saturation, reflectance loss, quarantine_mandated: False, governing_standard: ISO 12944 / IS 802

condition_id: rust, family: corrosion_coating, subsidiary: kec, display_name: Ferrous Oxide Red Rust Bleed, severity: High, primary_failure_mode: Active steel section loss reducing tower ultimate load capacity, visual_signature: geometry: Flaking or pitted corrosion bleeding from fastener holes or gussets, texture: High roughness, scaly exfoliating rust flakes, hsv_range: H: 5-25 (Reddish-brown), S: 120-255, V: 50-180, quarantine_mandated: True, governing_standard: KEC-PATROL-P01 Clause 8.4

condition_id: bent_member, family: deformation, subsidiary: kec, display_name: Structural Angle Leg Permanent Deformation / Buckling, severity: Critical, primary_failure_mode: Euler buckling of lattice tower leg leading to whole tower collapse, visual_signature: geometry: Deviation from straight chord exceeding L/500 tolerance, texture: Kinked flange or distorted gusset bolt holes, hsv_range: Shadow crease along deformed neutral axis, quarantine_mandated: True, governing_standard: IS 802 (Part 1/Sec 2)

condition_id: burnt, family: thermal_electrical, subsidiary: raychem, display_name: Insulation Thermal Scorching / Flashover Char, severity: Critical, primary_failure_mode: Dielectric breakdown, thermal runaway, and catastrophic cable splice explosion, visual_signature: geometry: Charred crater or blistered polymeric outer sleeve, texture: Carbonized brittle soot crust with molten polyolefin lips, hsv_range: Pure matte black (V < 25) with surrounding iridescent thermal discoloration, quarantine_mandated: True, governing_standard: RAYCHEM-HV-SOP-404 / IEEE 404

condition_id: tracking_mark, family: thermal_electrical, subsidiary: raychem, display_name: Electrical Partial Discharge Dendritic Treeing Path, severity: Critical, primary_failure_mode: Progressive dielectric erosion terminating in phase-to-earth flashover, visual_signature: geometry: Branched dendritic carbon tracks radiating along creepage path, texture: Fine micro-grooves etched into silicone or mastic substrate, hsv_range: High-contrast dark treeing veins across lighter insulator sheds, quarantine_mandated: True, governing_standard: IEC 60502-4 / IEEE 404

condition_id: uneven_shrink, family: deformation, subsidiary: raychem, display_name: Asymmetric Heat Recovery / Trapped Air Voids, severity: High, primary_failure_mode: Air void ionization under high voltage stress triggering internal partial discharge, visual_signature: geometry: Wavy ridge, wrinkled transition, or improper step-down taper, texture: Wrinkled skin indicating non-uniform torch heating, hsv_range: Contour shadow folds along sleeve circumference, quarantine_mandated: True, governing_standard: RAYCHEM-HV-SOP-404 Clause 10.3
